integrity.proof_coverage: Analytic all-integer trace moments, uniform Hilbert-Schmidt comparison, compact measure determinacy; numerical checker is a consistency test only.
integrity.scientific_status: Self-review correctness, originality and mathematical-value assessments passed; independent validation not performed.

limitations: Fixed -1<alpha<0 and delta down to zero. Threshold counting at fixed positive t, not uniform at zero. Schatten asymptotic proved for fixed real p>=2, not p<2. The historical relation to broad semiclassical spectral-asymptotic results has not been exhaustively resolved.
title: Critical spectral density of the differential Hilbert operator between weighted Bergman Hilbert spaces
